About Pragati Exim & Trade

India-Based Botanical Ingredient Exporter for Global B2B Sourcing

Pragati Exim & Trade operates exclusively as an international B2B export partner for global ingredient buyers, nutraceutical brands, pharmaceutical formulators, and food manufacturers. We do not sell retail consumer products or domestic retail packs.

By bridging verified Indian agricultural cultivation and advanced phytochemical processing with strict destination-market compliance, we provide dependable batch-to-batch consistency, complete technical documentation (COA, MSDS, TDS), and streamlined international freight coordination.

Herbal Powders Division

USDA Organic Certified whole plant, root, bark, and seed powders milled under gentle low-temperature controls.

Botanical Extracts Division

42 primary standardized phytochemical extracts with quantified marker assays verified via HPLC, UV, and GV.

Know More About Pragati Exim

Key B2B Supply Principles

  • 100% Export Focused: Pure commercial B2B supply model tailored to overseas importers, distributors, and contract manufacturers.
  • Comprehensive Documentation: Full export batch documentation including Certificate of Analysis, Heavy Metal Screen, Microbiological Analysis, and MSDS.
  • Flexible Export Quantities: Standard MOQ of 50 KG per product up to multi-metric ton containerized sea shipments.
  • Sustainable Partnerships: Long-term supply agreements ensuring consistent quality and transparent commercial communication.

End-to-End Workflow

Our Export Process

A structured step-by-step export workflow reinforcing our international B2B business model.

01

Buyer Inquiry

Submit your ingredient specifications, target assay, quantity, and destination.

02

Product Discussion

Technical review of pharmacopeial grades, mesh sizes, and country compliance.

03

Specification Confirmation

Alignment on detailed Certificate of Analysis (COA) parameters.

04

Sample & Documentation

Evaluation samples dispatched along with Technical Data Sheets (TDS) and MSDS.

05

Order Confirmation

Commercial invoice, Proforma terms, and production/dispatch scheduling.

06

Quality & Packing

Batch testing, food-grade double poly-lined packing, and palletization.

07

Export Documentation

Phytosanitary certificate, Certificate of Origin, Organic TC, and customs paperwork.

08

Shipment Coordination

Freight booking via suitable Indian maritime ports or international air cargo.

09

International Delivery

Customs clearance support and safe destination delivery to buyer warehouse.
